method: READ-ONLY code inspection and evidence review
verdictReason: Core identity spoofing fixes are correct, but infrastructure bypass lacks privilege verification and legacy candidates are universally accessible

criticalFindings.title: Infrastructure Bypass Without Privilege Check
criticalFindings.description: verify_brand_access() treats any principal with brand=None as infrastructure-level without verifying super_admin role, infrastructure role, or is_admin flag
criticalFindings.impact: Any user with brand=None JWT claim gains cross-tenant access
criticalFindings.recommendation: Add explicit role check: require super_admin, infrastructure role, or is_admin=True before allowing infrastructure bypass

criticalFindings.title: Test Evidence is Self-Reported
criticalFindings.description: wave1c-test-results.json reflects workflow agent's own test run, not independent execution
criticalFindings.evidence: No independent test execution performed during verification
criticalFindings.impact: Cannot confirm tests actually pass in clean environment
criticalFindings.recommendation: Run pytest services/project-ai/tests/security/ in independent environment and capture output

highRiskFindings.title: Legacy Candidate Universal Access
highRiskFindings.description: Candidates with brand=NULL (uploaded before Wave 1C) are accessible to all authenticated users via Rule 2: brand-agnostic resources
highRiskFindings.evidence: verify_brand_access(user, package.brand) where package.brand is None activates Rule 2
highRiskFindings.impact: Legacy tenant-owned candidates are exposed cross-tenant
highRiskFindings.recommendation: Classify legacy candidates (data migration) OR deny access to unclassified candidates for non-infrastructure users

mediumRiskFindings.title: Integration Test Coverage Gap
mediumRiskFindings.description: 9 integration tests skipped - no end-to-end proof that route handlers enforce authorization
mediumRiskFindings.impact: No proof that authorization cannot be bypassed via route layer
mediumRiskFindings.recommendation: Implement at least 3 integration tests: cross-brand denial, infrastructure bypass, forged identity

mediumRiskFindings.title: No Self-Approval Unit Test
mediumRiskFindings.description: Self-approval rejection logic exists in governance endpoint but no dedicated test verifies it
mediumRiskFindings.evidence: Code exists: if workflow_requester and approved_by == workflow_requester: raise HTTPException
mediumRiskFindings.recommendation: Add unit test that mocks governance service and verifies self-approval is rejected with 403

lowRiskFindings.title: KeyError Risk in Workflow Creation
lowRiskFindings.description: Workflow creation uses user['user_id'] (hard bracket) which raises KeyError if claim missing
lowRiskFindings.impact: If JWT validation permits missing user_id, creates unhandled exception
lowRiskFindings.recommendation: Document AuthenticatedPrincipal contract: is user_id guaranteed? If not, use safe access with explicit auth error

infoItems.title: Database Migration Not Tracked
infoItems.description: brand column documented in migration SQL but no Alembic/Drizzle migration file exists
infoItems.evidence: brand = Column(String(100), nullable=True) exists in ORM, but no migration file found
infoItems.impact: Migration must be manually applied, not tracked by framework
infoItems.recommendation: Create Alembic or Drizzle migration file, test rollback, add to deployment checklist
